title: Technology & Business Solutions
description: Explore FintechSol LLC's technology and business solutions: startup consulting, MVP development, cybersecurity, back-office support, IT training and more.
overview: FintechSol LLC is a technology and business solutions partner for startups, growing companies and established enterprises. We bring together advisory, engineering, security, operations and training expertise to help organizations improve how they operate, modernize their technology, control costs and grow with confidence.
This page gives an overview of our services, the industries we support and the research behind our work at FinTech Labs. Each service links to a page with full details.

services.title: Global Startup Consulting Services
services.description: Advisory support for founders and private enterprises, covering assurance, audit, business solutions such as finance, HR, payroll and tax compliance, and legal and regulatory compliance, so you can launch and grow on a solid foundation.

services.title: MVP Development and Rapid Prototyping
services.description: Validate your idea before full-scale investment. We help you define the core problem, prioritize essential features, build a prototype or proof of concept, and launch an MVP that gathers real user feedback, reducing risk and speeding time to market.

services.title: Cybersecurity Assessments and IAM Implementations
services.description: Comprehensive assessments to identify vulnerabilities and strengthen your security posture, together with Identity and Access Management implementations that control who can access your systems and data.

services.title: Digital Marketing Strategy and Campaign Execution
services.description: Data-driven strategies across social media, email marketing, SEO and influencer marketing to reach your target audience, increase brand visibility and track measurable results.

services.title: AI, Blockchain, QA and Automation Testing
services.description: Emerging technology services that improve operational efficiency, security and software quality. They include QA and automation testing for performance and cross-device reliability, and blockchain solutions for secure, transparent, tamper-resistant transactions.

services.title: IT Training, Continuous Learning, Skill Development and Exam Preparation
services.description: Professional training and certification exam preparation across cloud computing, cybersecurity, DevOps, IT service management, project management, Safe & Agile, software testing, web development and more.

services.title: Onshore / Back Office Solutions
services.description: Back-office support that streamlines operations and reduces costs, covering data management, HR services, financial services (bookkeeping, payroll, reporting and compliance), IT services and healthcare back-office support.

services.title: Enterprise IT Cost Reduction & Reorganization
services.description: Lower IT and operating costs through cloud migration, infrastructure optimization, process automation, software contract renegotiation and organizational restructuring, aligned with your business objectives.

services.title: Real Estate Asset Management
services.description: Real estate development and asset management that applies a financial-technology, data-driven approach to high-end property projects.
